title: Core: AS2 static class members
description: Test compilation of static class members: class Counter { static var count:Number = 0; static function increment() { count++; } static function getCount():Number { return count; } }. Test static variable access: Counter.count, Counter.increment(). Test static variables are initialized in class body. Verify ActionGetVariable (0x1c) + ActionGetMember (0x4f) for static field access.
